business_meaning: Unique identifier for a ShopFast order.
allowed_values_or_range: Positive integer. Required and unique by dbt tests.

business_meaning: Identifier of the customer account linked to the order.
allowed_values_or_range: Positive integer. Expected to match stg_customers.customer_id.
Valid calendar date. Missing or unparseable source dates become NULL.

business_meaning: Standardized stage of an order in its lifecycle.
Sales channel used to place the order.
Destination country code supplied for the order.
allowed_values_or_range: FR, DE, ES, BE in the current ShopFast data

business_meaning: Recorded gross order total in euros before refunds.
allowed_values_or_range: Expected lab range is strictly between EUR 0 and EUR 2000. Invalid nonpositive values are present in staging.

business_meaning: Identifier of the payment event from the payment provider.
allowed_values_or_range: Positive integer expected to identify one payment event.

business_meaning: Identifier of the order associated with the payment event.
allowed_values_or_range: Positive integer. Expected to match stg_orders.order_id.
Valid calendar date. Missing or unparseable source dates become NULL.

business_meaning: Method recorded for the payment event.
Amount of the payment event expressed in euros.
allowed_values_or_range: Expected lab range is strictly between EUR 0 and EUR 2000. A value of 78.79 represents EUR 78.79.

business_meaning: Currency code supplied by the payment provider.
allowed_values_or_range: EUR for ShopFast payments in the lab

business_meaning: Last four digits of the card when available from the source.
unit_or_format: Four digits as text, with leading zeros preserved
allowed_values_or_range: 0000 through 9999 when provided. NULL is allowed.

business_meaning: Status of the payment event recorded by the payment provider.
